The '''Dulok Village''' was a settlement of the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] of the [[Donkuwah]] tribe on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dulok Village was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The village was originally inhabited by the Duloks of the [[Korga]] tribe but,<ref name="SWG:DV" /> for some unknown reason, they were eventually replaced by Donkuwah Duloks.<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
